dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve with a notable singular notch located on the lower third of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, exhibiting minor morphological irregularity at the peak tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear slope of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the visible body segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible pixel base width is approximately 2.4 times the vertical height of the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear rake marks and depigmented scratches are visible across the lower lateral surface of the fin and the attached flank. A distinct notch is present on the trailing edge near the base.
other_distinctive_markers: Variable mottled gray pigmentation and multiple small, circular white punctate markings along the lower portion of the fin.
